title: Raytraced Diamond
description: A faceted gem whose material refracts the camera ray into the mesh, follows it against a GPU BVH through bounded total-internal-reflection bounces, and escapes into the environment cube map with per-channel IOR dispersion.
techniques: GPU BVH first-hit traversal inside the gem volume
bounded internal bounce loop with total internal reflection
mip-correct environment sampling from the ideal screen ray
